"""A FIB exercising every node type, local prefixes, bulk groups and all forests."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

def mk(K, pairs, length):
    """128-bit prefix: 64-bit front key K plus (bit offset, value, width) fields."""
    v = K << 64
    for d, val, n in pairs:
        v |= val << (128 - d - n)
    if length <= 0: return 0
    return v & (((1 << length) - 1) << (128 - length))

def rich_fib():
    fib = {}
    def add(a, l, h):
        assert 0 <= a < (1 << 128), 'prefix overflow'
        assert l == 0 or (a >> (128 - l)) << (128 - l) == a, 'not normalized'
        fib[(a, l)] = h
    K = [REDACTED:SECRET]
    # depth-0 forest: nested chain plus siblings
    for l in range(0, 17):
        add(mk(0x20010db800000000, [], l), l, l * 3 + 1)
    add(mk(0x20010db900000000, [], 16), 16, 77)
    add(mk(0x20010dba00000000, [], 12), 12, 78)
    add(mk(0x20010dbb00000000, [], 5), 5, 79)
    # 16-front forests with locals at several levels
    for l in range(17, 33):
        add(mk(K, [], l), l, l + 5)
    add(mk(K, [(16, 0x123, 12)], 34), 34, 60)
    add(mk(0x20010db900000002, [(22, 5, 6), (28, 9, 6)], 40), 40, 61)
    add(mk(0x20010db900000003, [(16, 7, 6)], 22), 22, 62)
    # 64-front forest: TYPE3 root with 20 children and local prefixes
    for k in range(20):
        add(mk(K, [(64, k, 6)], 96), 96, 1000 + k)
    for l in range(65, 71):
        add(mk(K, [], l), l, l + 500)
    add(mk(K, [(64, 21, 6), (70, 3, 6)], 80), 80, 71)
    add(mk(K, [(64, 21, 6), (70, 3, 6), (76, 3, 6), (82, 3, 6), (88, 3, 6), (94, 3, 6)], 128),
        128, 5)
    add(mk(K, [(64, 22, 6)], 70), 70, 88)
    # a second 64-front forest that is a bare leaf
    add(mk(0x20010db900000009, [(64, 5, 6)], 65), 65, 99)
    # 16-front forest with 9 children (TYPE3 at level 0)
    K2 = 0x20010db800000005
    for k in range(9):
        add(mk(K2, [(16, k, 6)], 40), 40, 200 + k)
    for l in range(17, 23):
        add(mk(K2, [], l), l, 300 + l)
    return fib

if __name__ == '__main__':
